title: Webb County Treasurer Raul Reyes Delivers Final Report After Eight Years in Office
excerpt: Webb County Treasurer Raul Reyes presented his final monthly Treasurer's Report to Commissioners Court on Monday, closing eight years as the county's treasurer.
content:
Webb County Treasurer Raul Reyes stood before the Webb County Commissioners Court on Monday morning to present his final Monthly Treasurer's Report, bringing to a close eight years of monthly reports on the county's finances, financial operations and investments.

Reyes, who has served as treasurer since 2019, said the role has been one of the greatest honors of his life. He thanked the County Judge for his words of recognition, the commissioners for their support, collaboration and trust, and the room for an unexpected standing ovation that he said touched his heart.

He said public service has never been just a job to him, but a calling, and that while his time as treasurer is coming to an end, his commitment to serving others and making a difference will not.

Source: Raul Reyes, Webb County Treasurer, Nov. 23, 2026.
